Game Overview

In Walter, the core idea is straightforward: join Walter in a pixelated quest across five escalating levels. Unleash strategic weapons, face evolving enemies, and navigate thrilling pitfalls. With its retro charm and engaging gameplay, Walter promises suspenseful fun that'll keep you captivated as you conquer each level and its surprises.
